_comment: TERRITORY MAP v7 — replaces the zip->day->tech grid (territory-grid v1..v6). A region is a named area a tech OWNS; the tech is a property of the region, not of a zip's day. Built 2026-08-06 from measured volume (region-capacity.mjs, 2026-07-27..08-07: 537 visits/wk, 155.2 h) and measured commute (tech-home-infer.mjs: the drive to stop #1 is 22% of all weekly miles). Assignment minimises that commute subject to balanced hours, with one Spencer override: Cory does NOT take the Plateau even though he lives 6 mi from it, because he is remediating Cammeron's work — and keeping Robert on the Plateau/Auburn belt puts the new tech nearest to both Cory and Spencer for support. That override costs ~69 mi/wk against the pure-mileage cut and is worth revisiting once Robert is established.
_supersedes: territory-grid-v5.json (day-pinning by zip). push-week --grid should no longer pin days from that file.

optimoRouteDrivers._comment: Driver records CONFIRMED to exist in OptimoRoute. Serials on this account are the full name. get_drivers returns AUTH_KEY_UNKNOWN and get_routes only reveals drivers that already have stops, so a driver with no routes is otherwise invisible — this list is what stops the sync pre-flight false-flagging them. THIS LIST IS HAND-MAINTAINED AND CAN GO STALE: it wrongly reported Robert Norton missing on 2026-08-06 minutes after Spencer created him. If the pre-flight flags someone you believe exists, probe live before believing the list (assign one order to that serial and read the response — ERR_DRV_NOT_EXISTS is definitive). create_driver is not available on this API key, so new drivers are added in the OptimoRoute UI.

Robert Norton.note: Returning. Existing ACTIVATED Jobber user. 24 of his historical customers fall inside his new territory (Enumclaw 11, Black Diamond 5, Ravensdale 3, Buckley 3, Bonney Lake 1, Auburn 1) — continuity is preserved, not broken, by giving him this belt.

Tavis Alexander.note: Returning 2026-08-17 into the arc Cory holds until then. His 1,032 existing forward assignments are from the OLD territories and are being re-sorted by region — he inherits whatever lands in his arc, not what he was previously assigned.

Cory Ventura.note: Steps out of the field when Tavis returns. Holds the Kent/Renton/Sammamish/Snoqualmie arc until 2026-08-16.

Cammeron Anderson.note: 318 forward visits to re-sort. Deactivate the Jobber user so nothing new lands on him.

Spencer Hill.note: 208 forward visits still assigned. Keeps jobOverride #8056 Madera West Condos only.

handovers.note: Territory does not move — only the name on it. Visits on or after this date go to Tavis; before it, Cory.

Plateau (Enumclaw/Buckley/Bonney Lake).note: Largest region on the board. Three separate runs, spread across the week.

Puyallup / Edgewood.note: 98371/98372 straddle SR-167 (Edgewood/Puyallup split) — never treat either as a clean city boundary.

Burien / SeaTac / South King.note: Moved off Robert 2026-08-06 (Spencer). Geographically near-neutral — 20 mi from Luke vs 15 from Robert — but it takes Robert's first week from 8.1 h/day to 6.8 and cuts the team spread from 12.4 h to 9.3. Revisit once Robert is established: at full volume this makes Luke the heaviest at 42.8 h and Robert the lightest at 35.0.

Thurston / Olympia.note: Most expensive drive on the board after the peninsula. Nobody but Luke is within 40 mi.

Peninsula / Gig Harbor.note: 18 min between stops — the most expensive region per visit on the board. 11 visits cost more than Burien's 20.

8056.note: Spencer keeps this account personally — an exception to his out-of-field status (2026-07-26).

capacity.note: 97% utilised BEFORE commute. Adding the measured ~9 h/wk of drive-to-first-job puts the team over 20 tech-days, which is why everyone is in overtime. Volume grew 507 -> 566 week over week in the sample; at that rate capacity runs out mid-month.
